docsApi.theSupermixerAppUsesThisApi: The Supermixer app uses this API for everything it does. You can use it from your own scripts too. Create a token under Account › Access Tokens and send it with each request as Authorization: Bearer sbp_…. Paths start with /api/v1, unless a section says otherwise. Endpoints marked public work without signing in. The others need you to be signed in or to use a token. The API enforces role-based access control.
